stem.text: A transverse progressive wave of wavelength $\lambda$ is set up on a stretched string. The graph shows the variation of displacement $y$ with distance $x$ at a particular instant of time. The wave has displacement $+y_{1}$ at distance $x = \dfrac{\lambda}{8}$.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement y against distance x for a transverse wave, with x-axis labels 0, λ/8, λ/2, λ, 3λ/2, 2λ and 5λ/2, and a dashed line marked y1.

stem.text: What are the next two values of $x$ where the displacement $y$ is again equal to $+y_{1}$?
